Elena (CSM): Quick sync on Saffron private/VPC onboarding — two things popped up this morning: network tests are flapping between our peering and their edge, and their SIEM isn't receiving audit logs. tagging owners.

Samir (NetEng): @Elena can you confirm which VPCs and peering IDs? I saw some asymmetric paths in the traceroutes earlier.

Elena (CSM): peering id: pcx-0a1b2c3d - saffron-prod <-> redwood-inference-01. first repro was at 09:12 UTC.

Samir (NetEng): copying the traceroute we ran from our infra node — shows hop 4 alternating between two routers. might be BGP flap at their edge.
```
traceroute to 10.244.12.1 (10.244.12.1), 30 hops max, 60 byte packets
 1  10.0.0.1  0.345 ms  0.256 ms  0.213 ms
 2  172.16.5.2  1.12 ms  1.11 ms  1.09 ms
 3  * * *
 4  203.0.113.9  45.2 ms  12.3 ms  45.4 ms
 5  10.244.12.1  46.0 ms  46.1 ms  46.2 ms
```

Tasha (Security): For audit logs: confirm that Saffron's collector (splunk forwarder) has the right destination and that our audit-stream role is allowed to put to their ingest ARN. Also we need KMS key policy to allow cross-account decrypt for their SIEM. minimal example below.
```
{
  "Sid": "AllowSaffronIngest",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/splunk-forwarder"},
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
  "Resource": "*"
}
```

Ravi (Saffron): we saw duplicate events between 09:00-09:30 and then a gap. retention for these audit logs is 90d for us — will that be impacted if you enable prefix dedupe or caching? Also what's the planned window for the final cutover?

Samir (NetEng): dedupe on our side is per-prefix TTL so retention stays unchanged. caching/prefix should not drop logs, just reduce re-ingest. Cutover window proposed: Thu 2026-03-26 02:00-04:00 UTC (low traffic) — ok for Saffron? @Ravi

Ravi (Saffron): Thu 26th works. can you confirm KMS key rotation won't break their ingest during the window?

Tasha (Security): We'll schedule a rotation only after we validate cross-account grants. short plan: 1) add splunk-forwarder role to key policy (dev env) 2) test decrypt + ingest 3) rotate key with staged alias. I can own 1+2 if someone from NetEng runs the tests.

Samir (NetEng): I can run the decrypt test and forwarder handshake. ETA tomorrow EOD UTC.

Elena (CSM): Heads-up — customer exec mentioned timeline tied to procurement review. If we miss completion before end of April there's a non-zero renewal risk flag (they may pause expansion). capturing as a commercial risk for AE.

Mick (CS Ops): @Elena can we capture feedback friction points now? I can send a 3-question survey to Ravi right after cutover and run a 30-min enablement session focusing on SIEM/KMS gotchas.

Elena (CSM): yes please. also can someone add a short playbook entry to the onboarding doc about cross-account KMS + SIEM steps? tag me when done.

DeployBot: Deployment note: peering-flap mitigation rolled to saffron-prod by Samir at 2056004550 — monitoring 30m.

Samir (NetEng): mitigation applied: adjusted BGP hold-time and removed a stale route advertisement from their edge. will keep monitoring. no further flaps in the last 10m.

Elena (CSM): Summary / next steps: Samir runs decrypt test (ETA tomorrow EOD), Tasha owns key policy updates (in dev then test), Mick sends survey + schedules enablement (post-cutover), Ravi confirmed cutover Thu 2026-03-26 02:00-04:00 UTC. I'll update AE and mark renewal-risk monitored until April 30. Please react with :thumbsup: when you have the action assigned.

Ravi (Saffron): thanks team — appreciate the quick turnaround :pray:
